edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet saw.
verses.hebrew: הַמַּשָׂא אֲשֶׁר חָזָה חֲבַקּוּק הַנָּבִיא׃

verses.english: How long, YHWH, must I cry for help while You do not hear? I cry to You, “Violence!” and You do not save.
verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה יְהוָה שִׁוַּעְתִּי וְלֹא תִשְׁמָע אֶזְעַק אֵלֶיךָ חָמָס וְלֹא תוֹשִׁיעַ׃

verses.english: Why do You make me see wrongdoing? Why do You look on misery? Destruction and violence are before me. Strife breaks out and contention rises.
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תַרְאֵנִי אָוֶן וְעָמָל תַּבִּיט וְשֹׁד וְחָמָס לְנֶגְדִּי וַיְהִי רִיב וּמָדוֹן יִשָּׂא׃

verses.english: So the law grows numb, and justice never goes forth. The wicked surround the righteous, and so justice comes out twisted.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן תָּפוּג תּוֹרָה וְלֹא־יֵצֵא לָנֶצַח מִשְׁפָּט כִּי רָשָׁע מַכְתִּיר אֶת־הַצַּדִּיק עַל־כֵּן יֵצֵא מִשְׁפָּט מְעֻקָּל׃

verses.english: Look among the nations and see. Be utterly astonished! For a work is being done in your days that you would not believe if you were told.
verses.hebrew: רְאוּ בַגּוֹיִם וְהַבִּיטוּ וְהִתַּמְּהוּ תְּמָהוּ כִּי־פֹעַל פֹּעֵל בִּימֵיכֶם לֹא תַאֲמִינוּ כִּי יְסֻפָּר׃

verses.english: For look, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and impetuous nation. They cross the breadth of the earth to take possession of homes that are not their own.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנְנִי מֵקִים אֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּים הַגּוֹי הַמַּר וְהַנִּמְהָר הַהוֹלֵךְ לְמֶרְחֲבֵי־אֶרֶץ לָרֶשֶׁת מִשְׁכָּנוֹת לֹּא־לוֹ׃

verses.english: They are dreadful and fearsome. Their justice and dignity come from themselves.
verses.hebrew: אָיֹם וְנוֹרָא הוּא מִמֶּנּוּ מִשְׁפָּטוֹ וּשְׂאֵתוֹ יֵצֵא׃

verses.english: Their horses are swifter than leopards and fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their horsemen spread out. Their horsemen come from afar, flying like an eagle rushing to devour.
verses.hebrew: וְקַלּוּ מִנְּמֵרִים סוּסָיו וְחַדּוּ מִזְּאֵבֵי עֶרֶב וּפָשׁוּ פָּרָשָׁיו וּפָרָשָׁיו מֵרָחוֹק יָבֹאוּ יָעֻפוּ כְּנֶשֶׁר חָשׁ לֶאֱכוֹל׃

verses.english: They all come for violence, their faces pressing forward. They gather captives like sand.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלֹּה לְחָמָס יָבוֹא מְגַמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם קָדִימָה וַיֶּאֱסֹף כַּחוֹל שֶׁבִי׃

verses.english: They mock kings, and rulers are a laughingstock to them. They laugh at every fortress, heap up earth, and capture it.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא בַּמְּלָכִים יִתְקַלָּס וְרֹזְנִים מִשְׂחָק לוֹ הוּא לְכָל־מִבְצָר יִשְׂחָק וַיִּצְבֹּר עָפָר וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃

verses.english: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass on. They incur guilt, for their own strength is their god.
verses.hebrew: אָז חָלַף רוּחַ וַיַּעֲבֹר וְאָשֵׁם זוּ כֹחוֹ לֵאלֹהוֹ׃

verses.english: Are You not from of old, YHWH my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. YHWH, You appointed them for judgment. O Rock, You established them for correction.
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא אַתָּה מִקֶּדֶם יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי קְדֹשִׁי לֹא נָמוּת יְהוָה לְמִשְׁפָּט שַׂמְתּוֹ וְצוּר לְהוֹכִיחַ יְסַדְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: Your eyes are too pure to see evil, and You cannot look upon misery. Why then do You look upon the treacherous? Why do You keep silent when the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
verses.hebrew: טְהוֹר עֵינַיִם מֵרְאוֹת רָע וְהַבִּיט אֶל־עָמָל לֹא תוּכָל לָמָּה תַבִּיט בּוֹגְדִים תַּחֲרִישׁ בְּבַלַּע רָשָׁע צַדִּיק מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: You make people like the fish of the sea, like creatures that creep with no ruler over them.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲשֶׂה אָדָם כִּדְגֵי הַיָּם כְּרֶמֶשׂ לֹא־מֹשֵׁל בּוֹ׃

verses.english: They pull them all up with a hook, drag them in with their net, and gather them in their dragnet. So they rejoice and exult.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלֹּה בְּחַכָּה הֵעֲלָה יְגֹרֵהוּ בְחֶרְמוֹ וְיַאַסְפֵהוּ בְּמִכְמַרְתּוֹ עַל־כֵּן יִשְׂמַח וְיָגִיל׃

verses.english: So they sacrifice to their net and burn incense to their dragnet, for by these their portion is rich and their food plentiful.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן יְזַבֵּחַ לְחֶרְמוֹ וִיקַטֵּר לְמִכְמַרְתּוֹ כִּי בָהֵמָּה שָׁמֵן חֶלְקוֹ וּמַאֲכָלוֹ בְּרִאָה׃

verses.english: Will they then keep emptying their net, killing nations continually and without pity?
verses.hebrew: הַעַל כֵּן יָרִיק חֶרְמוֹ וְתָמִיד לַהֲרֹג גּוֹיִם לֹא יַחְמוֹל׃

verses.english: I will stand at my post and station myself on the rampart. I will watch to see what He will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.
verses.hebrew: עַל־מִשְׁמַרְתִּי אֶעֱמֹדָה וְאֶתְיַצְּבָה עַל־מָצוֹר וַאֲצַפֶּה לִרְאוֹת מַה־יְדַבֶּר־בִּי וּמָה אָשִׁיב עַל־תּוֹכַחְתִּי׃

verses.english: YHWH answered me and said, “Write the vision and make it plain on the tablets, so that whoever reads it may run.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנֵנִי יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר כְּתוֹב חָזוֹן וּבָאֵר עַל־הַלֻּחוֹת לְמַעַן יָרוּץ קוֹרֵא בוֹ׃

verses.english: For the vision is still for the appointed time. It presses toward the end and will not lie. If it delays, wait for it. It will surely come and will not be late.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עוֹד חָזוֹן לַמּוֹעֵד וְיָפֵחַ לַקֵּץ וְלֹא יְכַזֵּב אִם־יִתְמַהְמָהּ חַכֵּה־לוֹ כִּי־בֹא יָבֹא לֹא יְאַחֵר׃

verses.english: Look, he is puffed up, and his soul is not upright within him. But the righteous will live by his faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עֻפְּלָה לֹא־יָשְׁרָה נַפְשׁוֹ בּוֹ וְצַדִּיק בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ יִחְיֶה׃

verses.english: Indeed, wine betrays the arrogant man, and he does not stay at home. He makes his appetite as wide as Sheol. Like death, he is never satisfied. He gathers all nations to himself and collects all peoples for himself.
verses.hebrew: וְאַף כִּי־הַיַּיִן בּוֹגֵד גֶּבֶר יָהִיר וְלֹא יִנְוֶה אֲשֶׁר הִרְחִיב כִּשְׁאוֹל נַפְשׁוֹ וְהוּא כַמָּוֶת וְלֹא יִשְׂבָּע וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֵלָיו כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֵלָיו כָּל־הָעַמִּים׃

verses.english: Will not all these take up a taunt against him, a mocking riddle about him? They will say, ‘Woe to him who piles up what is not his! How long will he load himself down with pledges?’
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא־אֵלֶּה כֻלָּם עָלָיו מָשָׁל יִשָּׂאוּ וּמְלִיצָה חִידוֹת לוֹ וְיֹאמַר הוֹי הַמַּרְבֶּה לֹּא־לוֹ עַד־מָתַי וּמַכְבִּיד עָלָיו עַבְטִיט׃

verses.english: Will not your creditors rise suddenly? Will not those who make you tremble wake up? Then you will be their plunder.
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא פֶתַע יָקוּמוּ נֹשְׁכֶיךָ וְיִקְצוּ מְזַעְזְעֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ לִמְשִׁסּוֹת לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: Because you plundered many nations, all the peoples who remain will plunder you, because of human bloodshed and the violence done to the land, the city, and all who live in it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אַתָּה שַׁלּוֹתָ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים יְשָׁלּוּךָ כָּל־יֶתֶר עַמִּים מִדְּמֵי אָדָם וַחֲמַס־אֶרֶץ קִרְיָה וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃

verses.english: Woe to him who makes wicked gains for his house, who sets his nest on high to escape the grasp of evil!
verses.hebrew: הוֹי בֹּצֵעַ בֶּצַע רָע לְבֵיתוֹ לָשׂוּם בַּמָּרוֹם קִנּוֹ לְהִנָּצֵל מִכַּף־רָע׃

verses.english: You have planned shame for your house by cutting off many peoples. You sin against your own life.
verses.hebrew: יָעַצְתָּ בֹּשֶׁת לְבֵיתֶךָ קְצוֹת־עַמִּים רַבִּים וְחוֹטֵא נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

verses.english: For a stone will cry out from the wall, and a beam from the timber will answer it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֶבֶן מִקִּיר תִּזְעָק וְכָפִיס מֵעֵץ יַעֲנֶנָּה׃

verses.english: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town with injustice!
verses.hebrew: הוֹי בֹּנֶה עִיר בְּדָמִים וְכוֹנֵן קִרְיָה בְּעַוְלָה׃

verses.english: Look, is it not from YHWH of hosts that peoples labor for the fire, and nations wear themselves out for nothing?
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא הִנֵּה מֵאֵת יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת וְיִיגְעוּ עַמִּים בְּדֵי־אֵשׁ וּלְאֻמִּים בְּדֵי־רִיק יִעָפוּ׃

verses.english: For the earth will be filled with knowledge of the glory of YHWH, as waters cover the sea.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ לָדַעַת אֶת־כְּבוֹד יְהוָה כַּמַּיִם יְכַסּוּ עַל־יָם׃

verses.english: Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink! You add your fury and make him drunk, so that you may look on their nakedness.
verses.hebrew: הוֹי מַשְׁקֵה רֵעֵהוּ מְסַפֵּחַ חֲמָתְךָ וְאַף שַׁכֵּר לְמַעַן הַבִּיט עַל־מְעוֹרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: You have had your fill of shame instead of glory. Drink, you too, and show your uncircumcision! The cup in YHWH’s right hand will come round to you, and foul vomit will cover your glory.
verses.hebrew: שָׂבַעְתָּ קָלוֹן מִכָּבוֹד שְׁתֵה גַם־אַתָּה וְהֵעָרֵל תִּסּוֹב עָלֶיךָ כּוֹס יְמִין יְהוָה וְקִיקָלוֹן עַל־כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃

verses.english: For the violence done to Lebanon will cover you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify them, because of human bloodshed and the violence done to the land, the city, and all who live in it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי חֲמַס לְבָנוֹן יְכַסֶּךָּ וְשֹׁד בְּהֵמוֹת יְחִיתַן מִדְּמֵי אָדָם וַחֲמַס־אֶרֶץ קִרְיָה וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃

verses.english: What good is a carved image, that its maker carves it? What good is a cast image that teaches lies, that its maker trusts what he has made? He makes idols that cannot speak.
verses.hebrew: מָה־הוֹעִיל פֶּסֶל כִּי פְסָלוֹ יֹצְרוֹ מַסֵּכָה וּמוֹרֶה שָּׁקֶר כִּי בָטַח יֹצֵר יִצְרוֹ עָלָיו לַעֲשׂוֹת אֱלִילִים אִלְּמִים׃

verses.english: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ and to silent stone, ‘Rise!’ Can it teach? Look, it is overlaid with gold and silver, but there is no breath within it.
verses.hebrew: הוֹי אֹמֵר לָעֵץ הָקִיצָה עוּרִי לְאֶבֶן דּוּמָם הוּא יוֹרֶה הִנֵּה־הוּא תָּפוּשׂ זָהָב וָכֶסֶף וְכָל־רוּחַ אֵין בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

verses.english: But YHWH is in His holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before Him.”
verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה בְּהֵיכַל קָדְשׁוֹ הַס מִפָּנָיו כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth.
verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לַחֲבַקּוּק הַנָּבִיא עַל שִׁגְיֹנוֹת׃

verses.english: YHWH, I have heard the report of You, and I fear. YHWH, revive Your work in the midst of the years. In the midst of the years make it known. In wrath remember mercy.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שָׁמַעְתִּי שִׁמְעֲךָ יָרֵאתִי יְהוָה פָּעָלְךָ בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים חַיֵּיהוּ בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים תּוֹדִיעַ בְּרֹגֶז רַחֵם תִּזְכּוֹר׃

verses.english: God comes from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His splendor covers the heavens, and His praise fills the earth.
verses.hebrew: אֱלוֹהַ מִתֵּימָן יָבוֹא וְקָדוֹשׁ מֵהַר־פָּארָן סֶלָה כִּסָּה שָׁמַיִם הוֹדוֹ וּתְהִלָּתוֹ מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: His radiance is like light. Rays come from His hand, and there His strength lies hidden.
verses.hebrew: וְנֹגַהּ כָּאוֹר תִּהְיֶה קַרְנַיִם מִיָּדוֹ לוֹ וְשָׁם חֶבְיוֹן עֻזֹּה׃

verses.english: Pestilence goes before Him, and plague goes out at His feet.
verses.hebrew: לְפָנָיו יֵלֶךְ דָּבֶר וְיֵצֵא רֶשֶׁף לְרַגְלָיו׃

verses.english: He stands and measures the earth. He looks and makes nations tremble. The ancient mountains shatter, and the everlasting hills sink down. His ways are everlasting.
verses.hebrew: עָמַד וַיְמֹדֶד אֶרֶץ רָאָה וַיַּתֵּר גּוֹיִם וַיִּתְפֹּצְצוּ הַרְרֵי־עַד שַׁחוּ גִּבְעוֹת עוֹלָם הֲלִיכוֹת עוֹלָם לוֹ׃

verses.english: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress. The tent curtains of the land of Midian trembled.
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת אָוֶן רָאִיתִי אָהֳלֵי כוּשָׁן יִרְגְּזוּן יְרִיעוֹת אֶרֶץ מִדְיָן׃

verses.english: Was YHWH angry with the rivers? Was Your anger against the rivers, or Your fury against the sea, when You rode upon Your horses, upon Your chariots of salvation?
verses.hebrew: הֲבִנְהָרִים חָרָה יְהוָה אִם בַּנְּהָרִים אַפֶּךָ אִם־בַּיָּם עֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּי תִרְכַּב עַל־סוּסֶיךָ מַרְכְּבֹתֶיךָ יְשׁוּעָה׃

verses.english: Your bow is laid bare. Oaths are sworn for the shafts at Your word. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְיָה תֵעוֹר קַשְׁתֶּךָ שְׁבֻעוֹת מַטּוֹת אֹמֶר סֶלָה נְהָרוֹת תְּבַקַּע־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: The mountains saw You and writhed. A torrent of water swept past. The deep lifted its voice and raised its hands on high.
verses.hebrew: רָאוּךָ יָחִילוּ הָרִים זֶרֶם מַיִם עָבָר נָתַן תְּהוֹם קוֹלוֹ רוֹם יָדֵיהוּ נָשָׂא׃

verses.english: Sun and moon stand in their dwelling. At the light of Your arrows they move, at the gleam of Your flashing spear.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁמֶשׁ יָרֵחַ עָמַד זְבֻלָה לְאוֹר חִצֶּיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּ לְנֹגַהּ בְּרַק חֲנִיתֶךָ׃

verses.english: In indignation You march through the earth; in anger You thresh nations.
verses.hebrew: בְּזַעַם תִּצְעַד־אָרֶץ בְּאַף תָּדוּשׁ גּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: You went out for the salvation of Your people, for the salvation of Your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked, laying it bare from its foundation up to the neck. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יָצָאתָ לְיֵשַׁע עַמֶּךָ לְיֵשַׁע אֶת־מְשִׁיחֶךָ מָחַצְתָּ רֹּאשׁ מִבֵּית רָשָׁע עָרוֹת יְסוֹד עַד־צַוָּאר סֶלָה׃

verses.english: You pierced the head of his warriors with his own shafts. They stormed out to scatter me, rejoicing as if to devour the poor in secret.
verses.hebrew: נָקַבְתָּ בְמַטָּיו רֹאשׁ פרזו [פְּרָזָיו] יִסְעֲרוּ לַהֲפִיצֵנִי עֲלִיצֻתָם כְּמוֹ־לֶאֱכֹל עָנִי בַּמִּסְתָּר׃

verses.english: You trod the sea with Your horses, the surging mass of mighty waters.
verses.hebrew: דָּרַכְתָּ בַיָּם סוּסֶיךָ חֹמֶר מַיִם רַבִּים׃

verses.english: I heard, and my belly trembled. At the sound my lips quivered. Rot entered my bones, and I trembled where I stood. I wait quietly for the day of distress to come upon the people who raid us.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמַעְתִּי וַתִּרְגַּז בִּטְנִי לְקוֹל צָלֲלוּ שְׂפָתַי יָבוֹא רָקָב בַּעֲצָמַי וְתַחְתַּי אֶרְגָּז אֲשֶׁר אָנוּחַ לְיוֹם צָרָה לַעֲלוֹת לְעַם יְגוּדֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Though the fig tree does not blossom and the vines yield nothing, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the flock is cut off from the fold and there are no cattle in the stalls,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְאֵנָה לֹא־תִפְרָח וְאֵין יְבוּל בַּגְּפָנִים כִּחֵשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה־זַיִת וּשְׁדֵמוֹת לֹא־עָשָׂה אֹכֶל גָּזַר מִמִּכְלָה צֹאן וְאֵין בָּקָר בָּרְפָתִים׃

verses.english: yet I will exult in YHWH. I will rejoice in the God of my salvation.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בַּיהוָה אֶעְלוֹזָה אָגִילָה בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי׃

verses.english: YHWH the Lord is my strength. He makes my feet like a doe’s and makes me tread upon my heights. For the director, with my stringed instruments.
verses.hebrew: יְהוִהּ אֲדֹנָי חֵילִי וַיָּשֶׂם רַגְלַי כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמוֹתַי יַדְרִכֵנִי לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינוֹתָי׃

translation_review: All readings compared with the pointed Masoretic text and revised where needed for precision and spoken cadence. Independent specialist and human read-aloud review pending.
